articles.title: Rs 116 cr sanctioned for free fish & shrimp seed distribution
articles.description: The Telangana government has approved ₹116 crore to provide free fish and shrimp seed to fishermen, aiming to boost local livelihoods and promote sustainable aquaculture across the state’s water bodies.

articles.title: A decade of inclusion: How GeM is transforming public procurement for women entrepreneurs in India
articles.description: Discover how GeM's Womaniya initiative has enabled over 2.24 lakh women-led enterprises to access public procurement and drive inclusive economic growth in India.
